title: R6B district - a setback above the maximum base height (ZR 23-433; reached by 23-432 and, under a commercial overlay, 35-632(a)): at least 10 feet from a wide-street wall and 15 feet from a narrow-street wall
description: DRAFT extraction (needs_review) of the setback-above-the-base rule for R6B. A setback is required only for the portion of a building street wall that EXCEEDS the maximum base height (45 feet for R6B standard residences, ZR 23-432); ZR 23-433 then requires at least 10 feet from a wide-street wall and 15 feet from a narrow-street wall. Under a commercial overlay the same depths are reached through ZR 35-632(a). The per-frontage wide/narrow depth and the trigger against the building height are read as a labelled draft in envelope_constraints.py; this rule records the wide-street depth. ZR 23-433(a) to (d) may reduce the depths.

citations.quote: a setback with a depth of at least 10 feet shall be provided from any street wall fronting on a wide street, and a setback with a depth of at least 15 feet shall be provided from any street wall fronting on a narrow street.
For portions of a building street wall that exceed the maximum base height, a setback shall be provided ... in accordance with Section 23-433.
For portions of a building street wall that exceed the maximum base height, a setback shall be provided ... in accordance with Section 23-433.
All regulations applicable to a district designation shall be applicable to such district designation appended with a suffix, except as otherwise set forth in express provisions of this Resolution.

inputs.name: zoning_district
inputs.description: Residence district governing the lot (scope enforced by applicability in_set R6B).

inputs.name: overlay_present
inputs.description: True iff a commercial overlay is mapped on the lot (profile zoning.commercial_overlays[] non-empty).

inputs.name: special_district_present
inputs.description: True iff a special purpose district is mapped; when true the result escalates to professional review.

inputs.name: street_wall_exceeds_max_base_height
inputs.description: True iff part of the building street wall rises above the maximum base height (45 feet for R6B standard residences); a geometric/design fact supplied by the caller. Not supplied -> no setback result.

outputs.name: setback_depth_from_wide_street_wall_ft
outputs.description: 10 = at least 10 feet of setback from a wide-street wall above the maximum base height (ZR 23-433). The 15-foot narrow-street depth and the per-frontage wide/narrow choice are read in envelope_constraints.py.

parameters.name: setback_depth_wide_ft
parameters.note: ZR 23-433: at least 10 feet from a wide-street wall.

steps.note: ZR 23-433: a setback of at least 10 feet from a wide-street wall is required above the maximum base height.

exceptions.description: No setback is required at or below the maximum base height; the benchmark three-storey 30-foot option (equal to the minimum base height) triggers none.

ZR 23-433(a) to (d) may reduce or adjust the depths (a one-foot-for-one-foot reduction with a seven-foot floor; optional beyond 50 feet of a street line or at a 65-degree orientation); not encoded here.
ZR 23 and 35 list R6 through R12 and do not name R6B; the rule reaches R6B through ZR 11-25 (suffix inheritance), flagged for the reviewer.
A special purpose district is mapped on this lot and may modify residence-district bulk; its provisions are not captured here, so the result is not emitted as final. Professional review required.

limitations: Draft extraction pending independent review and G6 qualified-human legal approval; not a Verified determination.

Only the wide-street 10-foot depth is recorded here; the 15-foot narrow-street depth, the per-frontage wide/narrow class (D-052) and the trigger against the building height are read in envelope_constraints.py.
The depth runs from the operative street line; This rule never measures geometry; the site facts are supplied by the caller.
